Veterinary Continuing Education is an organisation focused on online veterinary courses, all of which are RACE approved CE. 

The online veterinary courses described in this channel also include veterinary technician continuing education, as vet tech CE makes up a large portion of the free veterinary CE which we show. There´s often a misconception that finding free veterinary continuing education online means it´s not of the highest standards, simply because it´s offered at no cost. What we aim to show veterinary professionals through our channel, is the wealth of high quality free veterinary CE from top universities and institutions that´s available to veterinarians and vet techs.
